verdict.rationale: Reflect documents in-app one-click publishing: hitting the publish button makes an individual note publicly available at a long, hard-to-guess URL with minimal styling and branding. Nothing shows that published notes form a browsable, interlinked site, so the digital-garden part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a browsable multi-note site or garden structure, evidence that wiki-links/backlinks resolve between published notes, site navigation or index, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
